messages.content:
Mobile clients have been getting errors from the edge proxy since the last app release
(incident INC-2291), and the cause is in how the router matches paths:

- Optional parameters: GET /v2/reports gets a 404, although the manifest route for
  reports, /v2/reports/:period?, has the period as an optional parameter. README.md says
  a route matches with or without its optional parameters, and that a parameter whose
  segment is left out is not in the params at all.
- Trailing slashes: the new app adds a slash to the end of some paths. GET /v2/orders/
  works, but GET /v2/reports/2026-Q3/ and GET /v2/orders/A-1001/items/ get a 404, and on
  the files route the slash ends up at the end of the file path we pass upstream.
  README.md says one trailing slash is ignored except by strict routes, and that it is
  never part of a value.

Please fix the router so that it matches paths the way README.md describes. Once that
works, the three requests from the incident (GET /v2/reports, GET /v2/reports/2026-Q3/,
and GET /v2/orders/A-1001/items/) should resolve with our routes.manifest.json to the
routes the manifest has for them; edge match shows the route, its upstream, and the
params. Strict routes, wildcards, which route wins, HEAD requests, and the 404 and 405
answers should keep working as they do now.

Result of write:
wrote 362 bytes to routes.manifest.json
